calculation.description: For each tradable instrument, subtract its trailing 5-day close-to-close return from the same-day cross-sectional median trailing 5-day return. Higher values indicate recent underperformance relative to peers and a reversal candidate. Macro observation-only instruments are not used in the cross-section.

validation.regime_notes: Daily IC is positive in 2020-2022 (+0.048530), 2023-2024 (+0.031216), and 2025-2027 (+0.032951). Small 15-instrument cross-section requires conservative interpretation; stability is supported across three regimes.
